items.text: Today, I found myself in DR Congo during my travels for work. Rishi Sunak, our new Prime Minister, was unexpectedly invited to speak at a conference here. It felt surreal being in such an important setting with high-ranking officials from around the world. The presidential atmosphere made it clear how significant this event truly is.
